Certified B Corporation® Monos is proud to be the first North American luggage brand to achieve Certified B Corporation® status, joining a community of like-minded businesses committed to the highest standards of social and environmental stewardship. The B Lab assessment, at the heart of our B Corp certification, holds us accountable for our impact across five key areas – governance, workers, community, environment, and customers. This certification represents more than a seal of approval, it's a testament to our belief that thoughtful design can coexist with social and environmental consciousness.

veritree We’ve partnered with veritree to support reforestation efforts in the Old Bonjoge Forest, a 2,000-hectare forest near Kisumu City, Kenya. Much of the forest has been overharvested – this project will establish nurseries to produce and protect fruit and bamboo tree seedlings that can be transplanted, and begin to restore the regional ecosystem. This partnership will result in the planting of nearly 1.3 million trees in the area over the next 12 months.
